# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FLAT_BREAKOUT_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of EMA ribbon flatness (low volatility), a breakout often precedes a sustained directional move. Capturing these breakouts with the existing ride-the-ribbon management (TP1 at +50%, runner, chandelier profit-lock) can exploit the volatility expansion edge, particularly on J's winner days where ribbon flats preceded the rejection breakouts.

## Mechanism

Define ribbon flat as (slow EMA - fast EMA) < 0.15 (15 cents) on the 5m chart. A bullish breakout triggers when price closes above the high of the flat ribbon bar with volume > 1.5x the 20-bar average volume. A bearish breakout triggers when price closes below the low of the flat ribbon bar with volume > 1.5x average. Entry is at the open of the next 5m bar. Exit uses the standard BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON or BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON management rules (chart-stop-primary, TP1 at +50% at 0.667 qty, runner to breakeven after TP1, chandelier profit-lock trailing 15%, time stop 15:50 ET). Only one entry per flat-breakout episode is allowed (flat episode ends when ribbon spread > 0.30).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (based on $0.50 avg entry premium, 3-contract min, 50% risk cap).
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), autoresearch grinder tested 120 parameter combinations (flat threshold: 0.10-0.20, volume multiplier: 1.2-2.0, entry timing: open/close/high/low). High overfit risk due to multiple testing; walk-forward OOS essential to validate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Conducted walk-forward OOS (4-month held-out: 2026-02-02 to 2026-06-18) on top 30 keeper candidates from grinder. OOS exp/tr = $0.42 (Sharpe 0.31) for best candidate -- requires further validation.
4. **Real-fills:** Validated top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) using real OPRA fills cache. Real-fills P&L vs BS-sim diff: -18% on 4/29, -22% on 5/01, -15% on 5/04 (avg -18.3%) -- within ±20% tolerance.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/06 (-$180 simulated loss from whipsaw breakout in low-vol chop). Max drawdown: -12% of equity in 2025Q3 low-vol regime. Blow-up scenario: persistent low-vol environment (VIX < 12) causing repeated false breakouts and stops.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days contribute 68% of total P&L in-sample (flag: concentration >50% requires regime robustness check).
